description_en: Queries the outputs of a pipeline node
description_zh: 获取工作流任务节点输出
kebab_example: aliyun paiflow list-pipeline-run-node-outputs --pipeline-run-id flow-n06dn00000000rfc53 --node-id node-n06dn00000000rfc53 --depth 2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPipelineRunNodeOutputs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the pipeline job. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html to obtain the ID of the pipeline job
parameters.help_zh: 工作流任务ID。如何获取工作流任务ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html
parameters.name: pipeline_run_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the pipeline node. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html to obtain the node ID
parameters.help_zh: 工作流任务节点ID。如何获取节点ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The depth at which information about the node is queried. If you set Depth to 2, the information about the node and all its child nodes at the next layer is returned
parameters.help_zh: 查询节点详细信息的深度（层数），当Depth为2时，将会返回该节点及其下一层的所有子节点的信息
parameters.name: depth

parameters.help_en: The name of the pipeline node
parameters.help_zh: 查询的工作流任务节点的名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The field used to sort the returned results. The following fields are supported:

Name
Type
GmtCreateTime
parameters.help_zh:
用于排序返回结果的字段，目前支持如下字段：
Name
Type
GmtCreateTime
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order. This parameter must be used together with the SortBy parameter. Valid values:

DESC (default)
ASC
parameters.help_zh:
排序顺序，取值如下，与SortBy一起使用：
DESC（默认值）：降序排列
ASC：升序排列
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The output type of the pipeline node.

Model
DataSet
Metrics
ModelEvaluation
parameters.help_zh:
工作流任务节点产物（Artifact）的类型：
Model：模型
DataSet：数据集
Metrics：度量数据
ModelEvaluation：模型评估结果
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared pipeline job
parameters.help_zh: 被分享的工作流任务的ID
parameters.name: token_id

Outputs.description_en: The outputs of the pipeline node
Outputs.description_zh: 工作流任务节点的输出产物列表

items.description_en: The output of the pipeline node
items.description_zh: 工作流任务节点的的输出产物

ExpandableArtifactName.description_en: The expandable name of the output
ExpandableArtifactName.description_zh: 被扩展的输出产物的名称

ExpandedArtifactIndex.description_en: The expanded index number of the output, starting from 0
ExpandedArtifactIndex.description_zh: 被扩展的输出产物的索引号，起始值为0
ExpandedArtifactIndex.title_en: 被扩展artifact的索引号，以0开始
ExpandedArtifactIndex.title_zh: 被扩展artifact的索引号，以0开始

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The time when the output was created

Name.description_en: The name of the output for the pipeline node
Name.description_zh: 工作流任务节点的输出产物名称

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the pipeline node to which the output belongs
NodeId.description_zh: 输出产物所属的工作流任务节点的ID

Type.description_en:
The output type. Valid values:

Model
DataSet
Metrics
ModelEvaluation
Type.description_zh:
输出产物的类型，可能值：
Model：模型
DataSet：数据集
Metrics：度量数据
ModelEvaluation：模型评估结果

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of outputs for the pipeline node
TotalCount.description_zh: 工作流任务节点输出产物的数量
TotalCount.title_en: 符合过滤条件的作业数量
TotalCount.title_zh: 符合过滤条件的作业数量
